summary: Travel Time / Transition Cost A (full-stack, additive + fail-open). New SQLite travel_time_cache (additive migration 0011) keyed by uniqueIndex (provider, mode, origin_normalized, dest_normalized), CHECK status∈{resolved,no_route} + resolved-has-duration; only cacheable provider FACTS stored (transient failures not). Repo travel-time-cache.ts (findTravelByKey + idempotent upsertTravel, no provider calls). The map gateway gains a SERVER-ONLY travelTime(origin,dest,mode) → provider-neutral resolved{durationSeconds,distanceMeters?}|no_route or scoped error, via Google Distance Matrix GET on the same baseUrl (AbortController timeout, bounded retry, static errors — key/URL/error_message never leak; disabled→no-fetch). services/travel-time.ts buildDayTravelFacts (IMPURE, route-level): resolves adjacent scheduled pairs to cycle-73 geocode coords; missing/unresolved→missing_geocode (no call); same normalized location or coords within ~50m→same_location (no call); cache fresh(≤24h)→use, stale→refresh if allowProvider+enabled else stale-evidence, miss→one provider call if allowProvider+enabled+resolved coords else unavailable; a cached/returned no_route→unavailable evidence (NEVER fresh, reason travel_no_route); any gateway error/disabled→unavailable (fail open); dedupes pair keys → one provider call per deduped pair. The pure computeDayFeasibility gains an optional travelFacts map: attaches `travel` additively to each TransitionCost and adds Math.round(durationMinutes*travelMargin) to a gap requiredMinutes ONLY for fresh evidence with non-null duration (+gap_travel_included), else a gap_travel_* reason code without changing the requirement (stale/unknown is context, never hard truth); sequenceEnergy reads only costLevel so travel load is never double-counted; omitting travelFacts is byte-identical to pre-cycle-76 (existing feasibility 6 + context-switch 24 tests pass). Exported dayScheduledEvents so routes pair the SAME sorted adjacent set (gaps[i]↔transitionCosts[i]↔travel). /api/feasibility/day + /api/today build facts with allowProvider:true; /api/feasibility/day/preview is cache-read-only (allowProvider:false, no provider call/write); app.ts passes the optional mapGateway to both. Shared feasibility.ts adds TransitionTravel (.strict, status fresh|stale|unavailable|missing_geocode|same_location, provider-neutral, no raw payload) as optional `travel` on TransitionCost. Frontend Today.tsx TransitionTravelLine renders quiet travel copy on transition rows (fresh estimate accent; stale/unavailable/missing muted no-alarm; same_location nothing) + .feas-travel CSS. No browser provider call/API key, no reschedule/route-UI/LLM/cron/bulk/autocomplete. Roadmap cycles 72-76 complete. Committed 71aaf1f.
